Import Compliance Specialist

Portland, OR

Full Time

Mid Level

Share

Founded in 1964, American International Forest Products (AIFP), along with Affiliated Resources (AR), is part of Forest City Trading Group (FCTG), one of the largest suppliers of forest products in North America.

The Compliance Specialist is responsible for ensuring all domestic and international lumber import and export operations comply with federal, state, and international regulations.
